# Fix: gluetun healthcheck false-alarms + unpinned images (cosmo)

Diagnosis (verified live): the tunnel is healthy (Mullvad connected, daily blocklist refreshes
through it), but the healthcheck in `modules/media-server/default.nix` runs
`wget http://localhost:9999` — a hand-written check whose tool/semantics broke when the Aug 8
restart silently pulled a new `:latest` image (bare `image = "qmcgaw/gluetun"`). It has failed
every 30s since (~40k failures), pure alarm-noise. qbittorrent shares the (working) tunnel's
namespace — no traffic leak at any point.

## Changes, all in modules/media-server/default.nix

1. `image = "qmcgaw/gluetun:v3.41.3"` — the stable release current at the Aug 8 pull, i.e. what
   the host is running and has proven. NOT today's `latest` (re-pushed Aug 23, never run here).
2. `--health-cmd=/gluetun-entrypoint healthcheck` — the project's supported built-in (queries
   the internal health server; 200 healthy / 500 unhealthy). Keep the existing
   interval/retries/start-period/timeout values.
3. Pin qbittorrent likewise: `lscr.io/linuxserver/qbittorrent:latest` → the current stable
   versioned tag (query the registry; state which you chose). Same drift class, same cure.
4. One terse comment where the pins live: a bare tag makes every restart a silent upgrade; pins
   move only by PR.

Nothing else. Do not touch other containers or the module's structure.

## Verification

Match cosmo CI (read .github/workflows/), run the same eval locally, PASTE final lines. Note
plainly in the PR body that the healthcheck's fix is only fully verifiable post-converge (the
streak ending is the observable) and how to check
(`systemctl list-units --failed`, `podman ps` health column, and the operator's new waybar
widget once #749 lands).

Normal PR flow; merge nothing yourself.
